tagline: Stability engineering jobs, planned and tracked
brief: An offline-first app for a naval stability engineering team to track jobs, scopes, day-wise planning, team availability and reports. The mark should feel steady, precise and organised, and replace a generic stock anchor icon.
criteria: Success: ties planning to ships, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, keeps the app's deep olive green.

concepts.name: Planning Hull
concepts.idea: Four schedule bars, shortest at the bottom, form the side view of a ship: the planning board is the hull.
rationale: Joins the two things the app is about: planning and ships
Built from one shape (a rounded bar) on a 16-unit grid
A heavier three-bar cut keeps it clear at 16 px
Deep olive green stands apart from blue productivity apps

recommendation: Planning Hull, in deep olive (#2E3D28) with white on dark backgrounds.
next_steps: Live in the app: icons, favicon and header updated
Check it on your phone's home screen
Optional: professional trademark search before wider use
